shots.title: Choosing a story
shots.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create ONE new square lifestyle photograph for a Hey Kahani photography approval set, not a collage. Full image to all four straight edges; no squircle mask, black border, typography, graphics or watermark.
INPUT ROLES: first reference is the Kahani Player PRODUCT IDENTITY reference. Remaining references are PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE ONLY: study their intimate camera distances, spontaneous body language, playful everyday colours, believable natural light and tactile homes. Do not copy their people, outfits or room, and do not reproduce the rectangular devices or cards.
PRODUCT LOCK: use the first reference's real cream cylindrical player, rounded top, arch carry handle, five white embossed round controls in a cross (plus above; previous, play/pause, next across; minus below), Gulab red #D3000A woven speaker band around the lower body, and thin light wood base. Keep its reference proportions and realistic small tabletop scale, not enlarged or redesigned. Story tokens are flat CIRCULAR illustrated Koel discs, never rectangular cards. A Koel rests flat on the top plate, never in a slot. Reproduce the material realism under the scene's light, not a pasted cutout.
PHOTOGRAPHIC LANGUAGE: observational editorial children's brand campaign, close and emotionally specific, slightly off-centre composition, real skin texture and soft flyaway hair, believable lived-in contemporary Indian home. Colour comes from ordinary cotton clothes and a few textiles: greens, sky blues, warm yellows, coral. Clear natural skin colour with soft warm highlights and rich gentle shadows, whites still neutral, no overall amber or beige filter. Moderate depth of field keeps both the emotional gesture and product readable. Camera feels physically present at the child's level or casually above it, not a formal studio portrait. Children are Indian and naturally cast, with individual faces, dark hair and brown skin. Contemporary casual clothing. No ceremonial dress, exotic scenery or cultural props added to prove nationality. Nobody looks at the camera or presents the product to it.
AVOID: waxy AI skin, same-face stock children, frozen advertising smiles, spotless showroom sets, extreme bokeh, huge product, floating props, malformed hands, extra fingers, garish saturation, cinematic teal-orange grade, heavy grain, artificial stage light, any phone/tablet, competitor devices or logos. This is a generated photography concept.

SCENE: close child-height photograph at a low wooden activity table beside a bright window. An Indian girl about 5, medium-brown skin, straight black chin-length hair held back with one small green clip, wearing a sky-blue cotton T-shirt, is absorbed in choosing the next story. A small pleased half-smile, eyes following her hand. She gently lowers one illustrated circular Koel onto the cream player's top with her right hand, fingertips holding the rim without obscuring its circular shape. Her left hand rests naturally on the table beside two other flat round Koels. Player in the lower foreground, face just behind it; natural perspective, hands not exaggerated by an ultrawide lens. A soft yellow cotton cushion and blurred wooden shelf suggest an ordinary playful room. Focus on the quiet independence of the action rather than a big smile. Soft directional late-morning window light, 40mm editorial feel. Balanced square crop, child and complete player large enough to read.
